بَرَشٌ , in the hair of a horse, Small specks, differing from the rest of the colour; (S, K;) as also ↓ بُرْشَةٌ : (K:) or both signify a colour in which one speck is red and another black or dustcoloured or the like. (TA.) ―
-b2- And hence, (T-A,) the former, (A, TA,) or ↓ both (K,) A whiteness that appears upon the nails. (Ibráheem El-Harbee, A, K.) ―
-b3- And the former, White specks in the skin. (A.) ―
-b4- [See also 1.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
